entities.summary: Sofya Vladimirovna Giatsintova was a Soviet and Russian film and theatre actress, theater director and pedagogue, who worked in the Moscow Art Theatre (1910-1937), the Lenkom Theatre, and the Moscow Stanislavsky Drama Theatre (1958-1960). Sofia Giatsintova, the People's Artist of the USSR (1955), received the Stalin Prize, as well as numerous state awards, among them the Order of Lenin. She is the author of the book of memoirs Alone With Memories.
